question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        CASE 
            WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN home_team
            WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN away_team
            ELSE NULL
        END AS winning_team
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_win_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    WHERE winning_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY league, winning_team
),
min_wins_per_league AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
    FROM team_win_counts
    GROUP BY league
),
all_teams_with_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.league,
        tc.winning_team,
        tc.total_wins,
        mwl.min_wins
    FROM team_win_counts tc
    JOIN min_wins_per_league mwl ON tc.league = mwl.league
),
teams_with_min_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY winning_team) AS rn
    FROM all_teams_with_wins
    WHERE total_wins = min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league,
    winning_team,
    total_wins
FROM teams_with_min_wins
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league

            ELSE NULL

),
team_win_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wins

),
min_wins_per_league AS (

)

FROM team_win_counts tc
JOIN min_wins_per_league mwl ON tc.league = mwl.league AND tc.total_wins = mwl.min_wins
